description: This file defines a Swift class 'NotifyOverlayController' responsible for managing in-app toast notifications with a borderless overlay panel on macOS. It handles presenting, dismissing, and configuring notification windows, utilizing SwiftUI views and AppKit components.

classes.name: NotifyOverlayController
classes.description: A singleton class managing the display of toast notifications as overlay panels on macOS, employing SwiftUI and AppKit components.

classes.name: Model
classes.description: A nested struct within NotifyOverlayController that holds the notification's title, body, and visibility state.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Displays a notification with specified title and body, optionally auto-dismissing after a delay.

methods.name: ensureWindow
methods.description: Initializes the overlay window if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: presentWindow
methods.description: Configures and presents the overlay window with current notification content.

methods.name: targetFrame
methods.description: Calculates the position and size frame for the notification window based on screen bounds.

methods.name: updateWindowFrame
methods.description: Animates and applies the updated frame to the overlay window.

methods.name: measuredHeight
methods.description: Calculates the height needed for the overlay based on the content size.
